population: Post-exposure finite sensitivity audit of 10 previously inspected seeds. No winner, reweighting, fitting, or change to the reference model.
design: All 120 unordered triples in listed seed order, 32 trees per member, average company CIFs. Reference is matched drop9_support 74-input 42/101/202, not the 83-input root pointer. Include ten singles and ensemble320.
primary: Shrunk final termination. Both causes, 12/24 calendar months, 2025H24 predictions and function checks only. Primary stability comparisons use all unordered pairs, also stratify overlap 0,1,2.
metrics: Existing endpoint evaluator and yearwise ceiling top20, ties by existing ID rule; pooled re-evaluated and event-control-pair weighted within-year AUC. Finite distribution mean, sample SD, min/max, median, 5th/95th and anchor midrank percentiles. No bootstrap confidence claims.
functions: Same annual product of empirical training marginals including missing. Global shape days 365 and 730; both causes. All-native nonzero threshold 1e-14. Coordinates are full term-specific union grid across ten seeds including missing bins. Compare observed cells weighted by actual joint training frequencies and unsupported cells uniformly separately. Presence is full-grid/all-time; zero at a horizon is retained. RMS, Pearson where nonconstant, signed agreement on material cells and overlap of positive high-contribution regions (top fifth by cell value among the comparison region; ties included, positive cells only).
materiality: Absolute function or local contribution >=0.001 CIF (0.1 percentage point). Descriptive screen: appears >=90% of triples, median training mean absolute contribution >=0.001, disjoint-triple median shape correlation >=0.8 and material sign agreement >=0.9; for supported directional statements require material positive consensus cells covering >=10 distinct training companies and >=3 observed training companies with target event by the stated time. No significance or causal interpretation.
local: Use every evaluation firm at its own calendar endpoint, union of all main and pair terms, absent terms exactly zero. Top5/10 by absolute magnitude excluding submaterial contributions, lexicographic key tie-break; empty union undefined. Absolute-rank Spearman on common union including zeros; sign agreement conditional on both material, report denominator. L1 excludes separately reported baseline; relate to absolute risk difference. Stable/unstable illustrative cases fixed nearest 10th/90th percentile of firm median pairwise L1 (year/endpoint separately, first snapshot row breaks ties); actual rows private; public figure only aggregated low/high quintile profiles if >=5 companies.
support: Per pair actual train joint-cell companies and both target event counts at horizon, missing included, private detailed table. Public aggregates no cutpoints or company data. Low support <10 companies. Marginal product mass is not joint support.
exactness: Every triple, year and version: all train+eval rows, all native times plus zero and 365/366/730/731, both causes, merged forest, independently averaged member predictions, full lossless export and reload, explicit native component sum, path q<=2 and CIF constraints; max_abs_error <= 1e-10. No clipping.
performance_and_complexity: Report measured sizes/times and exact spatial/scalar cells. Contrast fixed 32/96/320 predictions, stability and complexity; conditional pairwise comparisons with shared vs disjoint members, no sampling claim for ten chosen seeds. No selection.
privacy: Private true cells, company rows, case contributions, model binaries and identifiers; publish aggregates, no per-company probabilities or explanations. No model fits.
